basis: Inference: conservative engineering mass allowances, not maker or measured masses. Body and mated-plug allowances are separate additive lumped masses. Validate by weighing the actual populated board and supported harness. Connector/capacitor dimensions: parts_qualification.md; GH drawings eGH.pdf pp2-3; DB125 drawing T0-1; MA drawing p2. No inherited R9 RF or SMA masses.
harness_rule: Strain relief carries cable mass beyond the modelled plug/local-wire envelope; unrestrained long leads invalidate these allowances.
